1. Item indicator
   * unordered
   1. ordered (in sequential projects)
2. (optional) checkbox
   * [ ] unchecked
   * [x] checked
3. (optional) priority indicator
   * \#flag
   * 🚩
4. **Task name in bold**
5. (optional) command tag
   * #project & (name | block_id)
   * #next
   * #someday
   * #note
   * #delete
   * #inbox
6. (optional) hard break, 1 or more tags
7. (optional) hard break, task's multiline description
8. (optional) hard break, block identifier
   * autogenerated short ^uuid
   * manual ^human-readable

## Examples

* [ ] #flag **Task** \#not-a-tag #next \
  #tag-1 \
  Description \
  ^uuid

1. [x] **Task**  #project project name \
   \#tag-1 #tag-2
   ^manual-block-id

* 🚩 **Task**  #project project name
  Description
  ^uuid
* [ ] one-line task sketch
